goal: Adopt post-quantum hybrid encryption and drop legacy ElGamal encryption for I2P nodes
Improves cryptographic strength and compatibility with modern I2P routers for I2P users
agreement: Substantive support with all prior objections settled
Support for adopting upstream encryption types and Java I2P compatibility (kevkevinpal, zzzi2p)
Initial objections over breaking older I2P peers were withdrawn after usage review (janb84, jonatack)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it upgrades cryptographic strength and interoperability for nodes on the I2P network
The benefit is restricted to I2P overlay users and is non-critical maintenance for the broader network
